description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

scenarios.scenario: A sustainability manager has drafted an annual ESG report in Markdown and wants to style the resulting presentation slides with an earthy, natural look suitable for an environmental audit.
scenarios.user_query: I just finished the text for our 2024 ESG report slides. Can you style the deck with natural earth tones, deep greens, and appropriate typography for an environmental report?

scenarios.scenario: A marketing consultant wants to browse all visual options before deciding how to style a client's strategy deck.
scenarios.user_query: Could you show me the theme showcase PDF so I can see what pre-built visual themes and color palettes are available?

scenarios.scenario: An e-commerce boutique owner is preparing a spring catalog landing page and wants to use a specific preset theme.
scenarios.user_query: I'm building an HTML landing page for our new jewelry line. Please apply the Desert Rose theme styling, fonts, and hex colors to it.

scenarios.scenario: A fintech founder has created raw HTML slides for an investor pitch and needs them to look trustworthy, corporate, and polished with navy and teal tones.
scenarios.user_query: Here are the raw slides for our Series A pitch. They look too plain right now—can you give them a polished, corporate maritime look with deep navy and teal accents?

scenarios.scenario: An event coordinator is creating an invitation deck for an exclusive VIP midnight gala and wants high-contrast cosmic purples and modern typography.
scenarios.user_query: I need to style this event brief for our nocturnal product launch. It needs a dramatic nighttime vibe with deep purple, lavender, and cosmic styling.

scenarios.scenario: A clinical research associate is preparing a summary deck for a pharmaceutical trial and wants a crisp, clean aesthetic using a known preset.
scenarios.user_query: Apply the Arctic Frost theme to my clinical trial presentation deck so the headers, body text, and colors match that preset.

scenarios.scenario: A farm-to-table restaurant owner has drafted a business proposal document and needs a vibrant, organic garden visual style.
scenarios.user_query: I've written up our farm-to-table expansion proposal. Can you style this document with organic garden colors like fern green, marigold, and warm terracotta?

scenarios.scenario: A DevOps lead needs to style an internal HTML tech architecture documentation site using a pre-defined theme.
scenarios.user_query: I have an HTML tech spec sheet for our cloud migration. Please style the page using the Tech Innovation theme with electric blue accents and dark gray backgrounds.

scenarios.scenario: An architectural designer wants their project portfolio slides to have a stark, modern grayscale aesthetic with no distracting colors.
scenarios.user_query: Can you format my architecture portfolio slides? I want a contemporary, minimalist look using only charcoal, slate grays, clean white, and modern sans-serif typography.

scenarios.scenario: A corporate training coordinator wants to review visual templates from the theme catalog before applying one to employee onboarding slides.
scenarios.user_query: Let me see the theme-showcase.pdf file so I can review the typography and palette options before picking one for my onboarding deck.

scenarios.scenario: A coffee brand marketing director is preparing an autumn seasonal campaign presentation and wants cozy, rich warm tones.
scenarios.user_query: I have these 8 campaign strategy slides that look super boring in default black and white. Give them a rich, warm autumnal palette with mustard and terracotta tones.

scenarios.scenario: A gaming startup founder is pitching a sci-fi indie title and wants to explicitly apply a preset theme.
scenarios.user_query: Please apply the Midnight Galaxy theme to my pitch deck artifact, including the FreeSans font pairings and deep purple/cosmic blue palette.

scenarios.scenario: An HR director is building a slide deck for a mental health workshop and needs a custom soothing theme that isn't in standard corporate templates.
scenarios.user_query: I'm putting together a workplace wellness presentation. Could you create a custom theme based on soft eucalyptus green, warm oat, and muted lavender, and style my slides with it?

scenarios.scenario: A wedding planner is drafting an event schedule document for a client and wants to use a specific preset theme.
scenarios.user_query: Take this wedding itinerary document and style it with the Desert Rose preset theme colors and typography.

scenarios.scenario: A non-profit conservation director has generated a quarterly summary report and wants grounded forest styling.
scenarios.user_query: Can you restyle this quarterly conservation report? It needs earthy forest greens, sage accents, ivory background, and serif headers.

scenarios.scenario: A growth marketer is finalizing a creative pitch deck and wants an energetic sunset aesthetic applied explicitly.
scenarios.user_query: I want to use the Sunset Boulevard theme on my marketing pitch slides. Please update the font families and color codes across all slides to match.

scenarios.scenario: A commercial real estate agent has an investment prospectus document that needs an executive, trustworthy appearance.
scenarios.user_query: Here is the HTML summary of our downtown commercial property. Please apply a sleek, trustworthy color scheme with dark navy, teal accents, and clean modern typography.

scenarios.scenario: A frontend developer generated an HTML report table and wants to style it using the Modern Minimalist preset.
scenarios.user_query: Can you apply the Modern Minimalist theme to this generated HTML report table? Make sure to use the exact hex codes for charcoal, slate gray, and light gray.

scenarios.scenario: A cybersecurity firm lead needs to present a threat intelligence briefing with an aggressive, cutting-edge tech look.
scenarios.user_query: I need these threat intel slides restyled to look like a cutting-edge cyber command center—dark backgrounds, neon cyan highlights, electric blue primary accents, and bold tech fonts.

scenarios.scenario: A product lead wants to create and apply a custom branded theme called 'Cyberpunk Neon' to their product roadmap deck.
scenarios.user_query: Generate a new custom theme called 'Cyberpunk Neon' featuring hot magenta (#ff007f), dark slate (#0f172a), and electric yellow (#ffe600), show it to me for review, and apply it to my roadmap artifact.

scenarios.scenario: A bakery chain owner wants to style their quarterly franchisee review deck to feel warm, culinary, and artisanal.
scenarios.user_query: I have an operations deck for our pastry shops. Can you re-theme it with warm bakery colors like chocolate brown, warm beige, and golden yellow with bold clean headers?

scenarios.scenario: A financial controller has completed a quarterly earnings slide deck and wants to use a specific preset theme.
scenarios.user_query: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to my quarterly earnings presentation. Use Deep Navy for backgrounds and DejaVu Sans Bold for headers.

scenarios.scenario: A renewable energy analyst needs a clean tech visual treatment for a hydrogen fuel white paper presentation.
scenarios.user_query: Make this hydrogen energy briefing document look crisp and clinical. Use ice blue, steel blue, silver accents, and crisp white backgrounds.

scenarios.scenario: A content strategist wants to explore available pre-set themes to see which one fits a new client's brand guidelines.
scenarios.user_query: What themes do you have in the theme-factory library? Can you list their names, intended use cases, and typography?

scenarios.scenario: A children's education app creator needs a custom playful theme with pastel colors for an investor deck.
scenarios.user_query: Our investor deck for our kids' learning app is too dry. Could you build a custom playful theme with soft sky blue, pastel yellow, coral, and friendly rounded fonts, then apply it?

scenarios.scenario: A wellness influencer is creating a downloadable PDF guide on herbal tea and wants to use a botanical preset.
scenarios.user_query: I'm releasing a tea blending guide. Please style the HTML export using the Botanical Garden theme with fern green, marigold accents, and DejaVu Serif Bold headers.

scenarios.scenario: A luxury hotel manager wants an executive deck styled with rich autumn sunset colors.
scenarios.user_query: Please take these resort performance slides and give them a warm, inviting visual identity with burnt orange, coral, and deep purple contrast tones.

scenarios.scenario: A startup founder wants to review the full theme showcase before applying a theme to their pitch deck.
scenarios.user_query: Display theme-showcase.pdf so I can inspect all 10 color palettes and typography pairings before choosing one for my deck.

scenarios.scenario: A travel agency owner needs to format a safari tour proposal document with earthy, savannah-inspired tones.
scenarios.user_query: I'm putting together an itinerary document for a luxury safari. Can you style it with warm sand, clay, muted rose, and deep burgundy tones with clean modern fonts?

scenarios.scenario: A history professor wants a custom retro-style academic theme for a lecture slide series.
scenarios.user_query: I need a custom theme generated called 'Vintage Academic' with olive green, burnt sienna, parchment cream, and FreeSerif typography. Show me the spec and apply it to my lecture slides.
